subject: RFP: Commercial — pricing structure, escrow & true-up (Stratos Finance)
messages:
From: Amelia Chen <amelia.chen@stratos-finance.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, procurement@stratos-finance.com
Date: 2026-03-29T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: RFP commercial questions — committed volumes / overage mechanics

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the quick intake last week. As we compile vendor responses for the commercial appendix, procurement has a few clarifying items we need you to confirm for Redwood's formal response: 

1) Committed volume mechanics: confirm whether committed tokens are measured as input tokens + output tokens, how unused commit is handled (carry-forward, refund, or forfeited).
2) Overage pricing: is overage billed at a flat per-token rate, or as a % premium over committed unit price? Any monthly caps?
3) Blended rates & mixed workloads: how do you price when customers use both generation and embedding calls in the same month?
4) Refundable escrow: can Redwood support an escrow or deposit to guarantee committed capacity for a period (we propose 3 months)? If yes, what are return/cancellation terms?
5) CPI / indexation: do you apply annual price adjustments and are there caps?
6) Currency & invoicing cadence: billing in USD, monthly invoices with net-30 OK?

We'd like a single-page commercial schedule to include in our RFP appendix and the contractual SOW. Can you confirm by COB 2026-03-31?

Thanks — if easier, send a short sample schedule + call time.

Best,
Amelia
Director, Strategic Procurement
Stratos Finance

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: rachel_kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-29T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: RFP commercial questions — committed volumes / overage mechanics

Team — forwarding Stratos' questions. Draft commercial schedule below; tagging Rachel for legal/terms and Priyom for finance confirmation on the math. Need final by COB Tues.

DRAFT commercial highlights (summary, not legal language):

-- Measurement & units
- Committed volume: billed against "service tokens" defined as total LLM tokens (prompt + completion). Embedding units are metered separately (per-embedding call).

-- Commit tiers & unit pricing (example)
- Generation tokens (seq model):
  * Committed tier A (>= 100M tokens/mo): $0.00045 per token (committed rate)
  * Tier B (>= 250M tokens/mo): $0.00036 per token
  * Tier C (>= 1B tokens/mo): $0.00029 per token
- Overage (pay-as-you-go): 120% of the committed tier unit price for the tier the commit falls into (i.e., overage premium).
- Embeddings: committed price $0.0018 / embedding unit; overage at 110% of committed.

-- Mixed workloads & blended usage
- The platform will compute a monthly blended unit price for generation by weighting usage across model classes (e.g., small-gen vs large-gen) and applying committed tier thresholds to the aggregate token volume. Embeddings remain separate.

-- Unused commit handling
- Carry-forward: unused committed tokens roll forward up to 3 calendar months only; after month 3 they expire. No cash refunds except at contract termination with a pro-rated settlement (see SOW).

-- Escrow/deposit
- Redwood can accept a refundable deposit equal to 1 month of committed spend held in escrow for the first 3 months; deposit applied to invoices thereafter or returned upon 60-day notice after the initial 3-month period.

-- True-up & invoicing
- Monthly metering with a quarterly true-up to align committed tiers. Overage will appear on monthly invoice (line item). Invoices in USD, net-30 standard; wiring instructions on the invoice.

-- Annual price adjustments
- CPI-based adjustment once annually, capped at +/- 3% year-over-year. Any changes will be communicated 60 days in advance.

-- Burst / capacity policy
- Short-term burst allowed up to 1.5x committed throughput; bursts billed at committed unit price plus a 10% surcharge if sustained more than 72 hours in a rolling 30-day window.

-- SLA / credits
- Standard Redwood SLA applies: availability targets and token-processing latency SLOs. Credits for downtime are pro-rated against committed spend.

Notes/questions for finance/legal: 1) Confirm the tier breakpoints and sample per-token prices above; 2) Confirm escrow mechanics are acceptable to finance; 3) Anyone prefer overage as flat per-token rather than % premium?

Thanks — I will draft a single-page schedule to attach.

-Neha
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: rachel_kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: RFP commercial questions — committed volumes / overage mechanics

Thanks Neha — I like the draft. A couple of recommended edits from legal/finance: 

1) Blended rate clarification: include a worked example in the one-pager for a mixed month (e.g., 200M gen tokens across g1/g2 and 150k embedding units). That helps procurement validate savings.
2) Overage mechanics: prefer a flat per-token overage for transparency. Proposed: overage = committed tier unit price * 1.10 (10% uplift) but with a monthly overage cap equal to 25% of committed monthly spend. This prevents runaway bills.
3) Escrow: modify refundable deposit to be "applied to the first two invoices or returned on 30-day notice after 90 days" — keeps cashflow flexibility.
4) FX: if billed in non-USD, include FX pass-through clause; default to USD.

Additional commercial lever proposal (for sales negotiation):
- Annual prepay (12 months) option: +10% discount on committed unit rates if Stratos prepays 12 months in advance.
- Volume true-up cadence: quarterly true-up and the ability to move to higher tiers mid-term (retroactive to start of quarter).

Attachments for the RFP: Redwood_Commercial_Response_v2.pdf (single page schedule), SOW-Stratos-Draft.docx (SOW template).

If Priyom confirms the numbers, I can sign-off and we send the DocuSign.

RK
Head of Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference

Amelia — appreciate the quick read. Attached is the single-page Commercial Response (Redwood_Commercial_Response_v2.pdf) and the draft SOW (SOW-Stratos-Draft.docx). Summary of updates per your requests: 

- Worked example (included in the pdf): scenario A = 200M gen tokens (mix) + 150k embeddings. Effective blended generation rate calculated with tiered breakpoints; overage shown as flat 10% uplift with a monthly cap = 25% of committed monthly spend.
- Audit logs: 13-month audit log retention included for Dedicated/Private deployments as an included compliance add-on; for hosted customers add-on is $2,500/month and $0.01 per 1k log events after free tier. (If Stratos is pursuing Private, include in SOW.)
- Prepay option: 12-month prepay receives an additional 10% discount to committed unit rates. Prepay refunds: pro-rated refund less administrative fee if termination occurs after 6 months; full refund not available within initial 6 months (finance can provide exact wording).
- Escrow: Redwood will accept refundable deposit equal to 1 month of committed spend for the initial 90-day guarantee window; deposit applied to invoices after 90 days or returned on 30-day notice thereafter.
